name: Challenge Manager
author: nerderror
description: Optional rules for harder runs, each with its own switch: no grind, whole-game mutators (1 HP, explosive shots, death blasts), permadeath and one-life runs. Works on its own or together with the Randomizer. 'No checkpoints' patches the game exe (supported Steam build only).

settings.label: No grind — farmable rewards become one-time
Won missions can't be replayed
settings.help: Story rematches (e.g. the Fabio fight) stay open until their quest is done. Stored in your save.

settings.label: Flagships/artifacts don't respawn, no daily floating loot
Mutators — the whole game, every mission
Crew have 1 HP
settings.help: Every crewmate (Captain too) has 1 HP; HP from level-ups, armor items and weapons is removed. Armor still works.

settings.label: Enemies have 1 HP
settings.help: Bosses and enemies whose script phases depend on HP keep theirs. Higher difficulties may still add a bit.

settings.label: Every shot explodes
settings.help: Every gun, yours and the enemies', gets a small explosion on impact (1 damage per bullet; your own blasts hurt allies a little, like grenades).

settings.label: Bots explode when scrapped
settings.help: Every bot, crew and enemy, explodes on death — chain reactions included.

settings.label: No checkpoints (Load Checkpoint disabled in missions)
Quitting mid-mission forfeits it (no quit-and-reload)
settings.help: Missions save about once per turn, so quit + Continue rewinds the turn. With this on, continuing a mission from a save returns you to the world map, like Abort. A crash mid-mission also costs the mission. Ship, bars and shops are not affected.

settings.label: Permadeath: scrapped crewmates are gone for good
settings.help: A crewmate scrapped in a mission never comes back: if you bring them again, they are scrapped right after deployment. The Captain is exempt. Stored in your save; loading a checkpoint undoes it, so pair with 'No checkpoints'.

settings.label: One life: losing a mission ends the run
settings.help: Defeat, Abort or quitting a mission ends the run: every combat mission gets locked and you have to start a new game. Note that a game crash mid-mission counts as a loss too.
